measures.title: Ocean County Natural Lands Trust Fund
measures.summary: Raises the tax rate for the Ocean County Natural Lands Trust Fund from 1.2 cents to 2.2 cents per $100 of total County equalized real property valuation. The fund, created by referendum in 1997 and amended in 2019, pays to preserve open space, protect watersheds and drinking water sources, and acquire, develop and maintain land for recreation and historic preservation. The official statement says a property assessed at $100,000 would contribute up to $22 per year.
measures.yesMeans: The County may levy up to 2.2 cents per $100 of equalized property valuation for the Natural Lands Trust Fund.
measures.noMeans: The Natural Lands Trust Fund rate stays at up to 1.2 cents per $100 of equalized property valuation.
